description: This file provides utility functions for translating errors to and from gRPC status errors, including mapping error types, attaching error details, and converting between native errors and gRPC errors within the containerd project.

methods.name: statusFromError
methods.description: Maps internal error types to gRPC status objects with appropriate codes.

methods.name: errorDetails
methods.description: Extracts detailed error information from complex error structures for inclusion in gRPC status details.

methods.name: toProtoMessage
methods.description: Converts an error to a protobuf message, avoiding double encoding and handling typeurl marshaling.

methods.name: rebaseMessage
methods.description: Removes redundant error message suffixes when remapping errors over gRPC.
